name: Ponytail
description: Lazy senior dev mode for your coding agent: the smallest complete change, reuse before new code, reviews that read beyond the diff. Adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail (MIT).
author: Dietrich Gebert (upstream); PI-Desktop adaptation by guanwenbo

en.name: Ponytail
en.description: Lazy senior dev mode: the smallest complete change, reuse before new code, senior-dev style review and audit. Skills only; no tools, no network, no file writes.
en.safetyNotes: Injects skill instructions into the agent prompt only. No filesystem, network, or key access. Changes how the agent writes code (smaller diffs, reuse first); disable on the plugins page to restore default behavior.

zh-CN.name: Ponytail 懒人资深工程师
zh-CN.description: 让编码 Agent 像最老练的资深工程师一样只写必要的最少代码：先复用、再标准库/平台原生、最后最小实现；附 diff 评审、全仓审计、技术债台账。纯技能包，无工具、不联网、不写盘。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 仅向 Agent 提示词注入技能说明，不访问文件系统、网络或密钥。会改变 Agent 写代码风格（更小改动、优先复用）；在插件页禁用即可恢复默认行为。

changelog: 1.0.0 — First official PI-Desktop release. Migrated from DietrichGebert/ponytail v5.3.3 (MIT): core lazy-senior-dev ruleset, ponytail-review, ponytail-audit, ponytail-debt, and a Desktop-adapted help card. Claude Code-only band/board/hooks and the gain scoreboard are not included.
safetyNotes: Prompt-injection only (agent.prompt.inject). No fs/net/secret permissions. Upstream rules never cut validation, error handling, security, or accessibility.
